pos.personaBrief: Botafogo kept 54.6% possession circulating at the back (FotMob) but dropped into a 4-4-2 block and attacked in transition (FotMob, TFA), so possession is a means, not a goal.

pro.personaBrief: Vertical, direct play with many long balls to the front four (FotMob, Correio), though with calm build-up at the back until the press triggers (TFA).

est.personaBrief: Pairs and close combinations as a shortcut, false nine and fluid rotations (Correio), with a drilled 4-2-4 structure.

lar.personaBrief: Top crossers in the Brasileirao, chance creation from wide areas and half spaces, 4-2-4 with wide forwards (TFA, FotMob).

blo.personaBrief: Stated and early-season high press (Trivela), later dropping into a mid/low 4-4-2 block (FotMob); the stated view and the opening weeks lean high.

mar.personaBrief: No marking evidence in the sources; answered from the modern default of zonal organization with compact block.

pla.personaBrief: Stated a Botafogo always the same against anyone (Itatiaia), plans followed to the letter (IstoE), with in-game tweaks like three center-backs in the final.

res.personaBrief: Wants a joyful game with spectacle (Itatiaia) yet won everything and closed the Libertadores final with an extra defender (Correio).

sis.personaBrief: Strong, rehearsed plans followed by all (IstoE) with stars like Almada fitted into a system; his idea comes first.

jog.personaBrief: Fast, direct front four and technical creators like Almada, combined with high intensity and aerial set-piece strength (TFA).

bas.personaBrief: Title built on experienced internationals and signings like Almada, Savarino, Luiz Henrique, with veterans rotated (IstoE, Correio).

lid.personaBrief: Mixes firmness and warmth (Itatiaia), talks to stars during play (Hudl), plan followed strictly by everyone.
